newsitem.title: USA: Anchor Gaming plans review of new casino.
newsitem.headline: Anchor Gaming plans review of new casino.

text.p: Anchor Gaming said it will re-evaluate the "scope and nature" of a planned new casino that would expand the gambling operations near its Colorado Central Station Casino.
"Our re-evaluation of the proposed expansion is based on our commitment to maximize stockholder value," Stan Fulton, chairman, said in a statement released late Monday.
Anchor Gaming shares were off 6-3/4 at 32-1/4 in early trading on Tuesday.
Anchor Gaming is improving the parking lot at Colorado Central Station, and it has now completed an expansion that added 10 percent more slot machines to the casino floor.

Fulton noted the company has been able to grow earnings per share at 43 percent annually over the last six years. In its most recent quarter ended September 30, the company earned $0.60 a share on $35.2 million in revenue versus $0.43 a share on $27.8 million in revenue one year ago.
Anchor Gaming operates two casinos in Colorado, develops slot machines and other gaming equipment and operates a slot machine route in Nevada.
